CT-0409 |homeworld=[[Kamino]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |birth= |death=[[18 BBY]], [[Coruscant]]{{TBBDate|207}} |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{TBB|The Clone Conspiracy}} |pronouns=He/him{{Databank|slip|Slip}} |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s {{C|6[[Foot|ft]]}} |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' **[[Grand Army of the Republic]] *[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Military]] *[[Clone Underground]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Slip''', designated '''CT-0409''', was a [[cloning|clone]] [[stormtrooper]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire]], who served aboard [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]]'s [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] during the [[Attack on Kamino|attack]] on [[Kamino]] and the [[Aerial bombardment|bombardment]] of [[Tipoca City]]. Following the events, Slip had strong regrets about being complicit in the operation, and expressed such sentiments to his companion [[Cade]] at [[79's]], a [[Cantina|bar]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. When Cade was assassinated by [[Clone X]], Slip fled and contacted [[Rex]], who was now leading the [[Clone Underground]], to find a way to escape. However, he would ultimately also be killed by Clone X. ==Biography== In [[18 BBY]], the [[Cloning|clone]] designated CT-0409, who adopted the name Slip, was serving aboard [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[VZ-114]] of [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] and witnessed him issue the order to [[Attack on Kamino|orbitally bombard]] [[Tipoca City]]. He took part in the subsequent attack. Later, he was aware of the cover-up that Rampart attempted in order to pass the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]]. [[Time|Several months later]], Slip was drinking at [[79's]], a [[cantina]] on [[Coruscant]] which catered to [[clone trooper]]s, with fellow clone [[Cade]]. Cade was also present at [[Kamino]], and announced his intention to whistleblow about the true nature of the operation, after Rampart had convinced the [[Imperial Senate]] that a storm had befallen Kamino and [[Death|killed]] its [[Kaminoan|inhabitants]]. He followed Cade out of the bar and tried to warn him about Rampart's unpredictable nature and cruelty towards clones, but Cade was suddenly killed by [[Clone X]], a [[Clone X trooper|clone assassin]] sent by Rampart. Slip was able to escape on a [[speeder bike]]. [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]] later visited 79's, in order to gauge the opinions of clones about their future within the Empire if Rampart's legislation, the Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill{{Databank|imperial-defense-recruitment-bill|Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill}} was passed by the Senate. When she had finished and the clones had dispersed, Slip informed her secretly about the true story behind Kamino's fate. He told her his designation, CT-0409, so she could cross-reference his story and prove that he had been present. Slip then contacted [[Rex]], a former [[Clone Captain]]{{Databank|clone-captain-rex|Clone Captain Rex}} who had become the leader of the [[Clone Underground]], in order to arrange his escape from Coruscant, and they agreed to meet at a rendezvous point. However, he was being hunted by both the assassin and Senator Chuchi, who wanted him to testify to the senate that Rampart had ordered the destruction of Kamino and genocide of the Kaminoan population. He told Senator Chuchi that he had saved a backup of Rampart's ship's command log to its central system, which would contain the evidence needed to prove that the destruction of Kamino was deliberate. He was then killed by Clone X, who had followed the senator. ==Personality and traits== Serving Rampart during the incident on Kamino, Slip followed orders and allowed Tipoca City to be destroyed. However, after the incident, Slip's actions did not sit well with him or his friend Cade. Slip looked out for Cade, warning him to be careful when he tried to expose Rampart's cover story for what truly happened on Kamino. Following Cade's death, Slip became determined to finish his friend's mission. Although he trusted Senator Chuchi enough to tell her the truth about Tipoca City and Cade's death, he primarily feared a similar retribution from Rampart. He was careful and paranoid, deciding it would be wise to leave Coruscant and contacting Rex to do so. Although he was stealthy enough to avoid Rampart's agents, he was unable to hide from Chuchi's guards, who discovered him and unintentionally allowed Clone X to discover him as well. Slip wore the standard [[Color|gray]] uniform of a [[Clone trooper officer|clone officer]]. He was capable with a [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 hand blaster]] and also able to drive a [[speeder]]. He was a quick thinker, escaping from Clone X when pinned down by using a speeder as cover and eventually as a means to flee the area. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|The Clone Conspiracy}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/joel-aron-star-wars-the-bad-batch-interview|text="We Keep Pushing": Joel Aron on Elevating the Look of ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch''}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{SWCT|set=Platinum 2024|cardname=Slip}} *{{Databank|cade|Cade}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|slip|Slip}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=CT-0409 |ja=CT-0409 |ka=კს-0409 |pl=CT-0409 |tr=Slip (klon asker) }} [[Category:Clone stormtroopers]] [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Clone Underground members]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
